title: Scholarship and scheme discovery
objective: Make scholarship and government-scheme discovery source-first, diverse and explicit about incomplete data.
guardrails: Starter catalogue has one dated NSP portal notice plus portal references for courses, skill pathways, career services, apprenticeships, learning resources and language technology.
exitCriteria: Student can filter/search listings, see provider/source/date, open official source, and sees a warning when criteria are not configured.
prototypeBoundary: This phase uses the Phase 09–17 prototype contracts. Database persistence and production auth are not claimed.
